answer_language.what: the share of SQAD 3.2 full's yes/no questions each model answers with yes or no in English, although the prompt asks for ano or ne

dial.what: the English dial as levels: EM of Ministral 3 3B and 8B against gold-in-context, HotpotQA and NQ

families.what: Czech RAG: each model's EM with yes and no mapped, with its 95% interval, on the four sets

pipeline.what: one configuration on one machine, with the budgets and the two moves marked; no data

social_card.what: the social preview card for the repository's settings, 1280 x 640, with the smaller models of families

version_gap.what: the gap between the SQAD versions, on all questions and on the questions the debias rule passes

note: Every value each figure draws, with the file and the JSON path it was read from. Written by scripts/figures.py; scripts/number_audit.py reads each value again.
